svg.title: Scientific claim evaluation workflow
svg.desc: A five-stage evidence workflow moving from a testable claim through source classification, experimental context, confounder checks and a qualified decision.
svg.text: How to evaluate a plant-science claim
Follow the evidence before translating a result into a cultivation recommendation.

g.text: 1. Define the claim and measurable outcome
2. Check source type, methods and direct relevance
3. Match genotype, stage, environment and measurement units
4. Examine controls, confounders, replication and uncertainty
5. State the supported conclusion and its limits
